name: L'Ambroisie
description: An exquisite three-Michelin-star fine dining experience offering classic French gastronomy. Located in the heart of Downtown, L'Ambroisie combines imperial elegance with timeless culinary perfection. Perfect for romantic dates and celebratory high-end dinners.

menu.name: Foie Gras Terrine
menu.description: Served with caramelized figs, aged balsamic glaze, and toasted homemade brioche.

menu.name: Roasted Sea Bass with Caviar
menu.description: Wild sea bass fillet served with white butter sauce and premium sturgeon caviar.

menu.name: Classic Beef Rossini
menu.description: Prime beef tenderloin topped with seared foie gras, sliced black truffles, and Madeira wine reduction.

menu.name: Grand Grand Marnier Soufflé
menu.description: Light, warm soufflé infused with orange liqueur, served with Madagascar vanilla bean ice cream.

reviews.comment: Absolutely celestial experience. The beef Rossini literally melted in my mouth, and the service was flawless. The dark gold styling of the dining hall is stunning.
Pricey but worth every single penny. It's the gold standard of French fine dining in New York.

name: Sakura Zen
description: A tranquil haven serving authentic Japanese Kaiseki and Omakase. Master chefs craft seasonal menus combining traditional techniques with contemporary aesthetics. Experience harmony on every plate.

menu.name: A5 Wagyu Gyoza
menu.description: Pan-seared Japanese A5 Wagyu dumplings, infused with ginger and scallions, served with truffle ponzu.

menu.name: Premium Omakase Platter
menu.description: 12 pieces of chef's daily selection of seasonal Nigiri, including Fatty Tuna (Otoro) and Sea Urchin (Uni).

menu.name: Miso Glazed Black Cod
menu.description: Succulent cod marinated for 72 hours in sweet saikyo miso, broiled to a caramelized golden brown.

menu.name: Matcha Lava Cake
menu.description: Warm green tea cake with a molten matcha chocolate center, served with red bean gelato.

reviews.comment: Authentic, fresh, and beautifully plated. The sake flight selection is remarkable. Reminds me of top restaurants in Kyoto.
Beautiful ambiance and delicious black cod. Booking online was very easy! Would love to sit at the counter next time.

name: Pizzeria Bella
description: Cozy, rustic Italian restaurant specializing in wood-fired Neapolitan pizzas and artisanal handmade pasta. High-quality ingredients imported directly from Campania, served in a lively, warm environment.

menu.name: Arancini di Riso
menu.description: Crispy saffron risotto balls stuffed with molten mozzarella cheese and ragu, served with warm marinara.

menu.name: Margherita D.O.C.
menu.description: San Marzano tomatoes, fresh buffalo mozzarella, fresh basil leaves, and a drizzle of organic extra virgin olive oil.

menu.name: Truffle Gnocchi
menu.description: Pillowy potato gnocchi tossed in a rich, creamy white truffle paste, wild mushrooms, and shaved parmesan.

menu.name: Classic Tiramisu
menu.description: Espresso-soaked ladyfingers layered with rich mascarpone cream and dusted with dark cocoa powder.

reviews.comment: The Margherita pizza crust is perfect - thin, charred, and chewy. Just like Napoli! The gnocchi is super rich.
Lovely patio seating, delicious food, and friendly staff. Highly recommend for family dinners.

name: The Golden Tandoor
description: Immerse yourself in the rich aromas and flavors of subcontinental royalty. We offer a modern twist on royal North and South Indian delicacies, featuring our trademark clay-oven (tandoor) specialties.

menu.name: Tandoori Paneer Tikka
menu.description: Cottage cheese chunks marinated in spiced yogurt and grilled to smoky perfection in our clay oven.

menu.name: Butter Chicken Deluxe
menu.description: Tender tandoori chicken simmered in a creamy, velvety tomato sauce rich in butter, cream, and dry fenugreek leaves.

menu.name: Awadhi Lamb Biryani
menu.description: Fragrant basmati rice layered with juicy spiced lamb, cooked on 'dum' (slow steam) with saffron and rose water.

menu.name: Gulab Jamun with Rabri
menu.description: Warm, golden milk-solid dumplings soaked in cardamom sugar syrup, served on a bed of chilled condensed milk cream.

reviews.comment: Absolutely outstanding Butter Chicken! The garlic naan was fluffy and buttery. Ambiance is upscale and matches the royal theme.

name: El Sombrero
description: Vibrant and high-energy Mexican cocina and cantina in Soho. Famous for artisanal cocktails, hand-pressed blue corn tortillas, and rich, complex moles. Great for group dinners and festive weekend brunches.

menu.name: Tableside Guacamole
menu.description: Fresh Hass avocados smashed at your table with cilantro, lime, onions, tomatoes, and serrano chilies. Served with warm chips.

menu.name: Slow-Braised Birria Tacos
menu.description: Three corn tortillas stuffed with tender, juicy pulled beef and melted cheese, toasted on the griddle. Served with hot consommé broth for dipping.

menu.name: Chipotle Grilled Shrimp
menu.description: Jumbo tiger prawns marinated in smoky chipotle adobo, grilled and served over cilantro lime rice with avocado salsa.

menu.name: Churros con Chocolate
menu.description: Crispy, golden pastry dough dusted with cinnamon sugar, served with warm, thick Mexican chocolate dip.

reviews.comment: The Birria Tacos are legendary here! Pair them with their house margaritas. Will definitely book again.

name: Le Petit Café
description: A charming, plant-filled Parisian escape in the heart of Greenwich Village. Offering artisan coffees, fresh pastries, and light, health-conscious breakfast/brunch items in a relaxing greenhouse setting.

menu.name: Almond Croissant
menu.description: Flaky, buttery croissant filled with rich almond frangipane cream and topped with toasted sliced almonds.

menu.name: Croissant Benedict
menu.description: Two poached organic eggs, smoked ham, and velvety hollandaise sauce served on a split buttery croissant.

menu.name: Avocado Toast Tartine
menu.description: Smashed avocado, heirloom cherry tomatoes, radishes, feta cheese, and microgreens on toasted sourdough bread.

menu.name: Rose Latte
menu.description: Double espresso shot with steamed milk, organic rose-water syrup, and dried rose petals.

reviews.comment: Super cute cafe! Perfect place to read a book or catch up with a friend. The Rose Latte is a work of art.

name: Folks
description: here wine with the beautiful view from roof top of the sunset
